Subject: Final settlement items & escrow release request

Hi Sean,

We are wrapping up the contract for the 2027–2028 term and need to confirm a few items before we can release the final payment from escrow. Please confirm the following so our treasury team can close the PO: 

1) Final invoice that shows the true-up line items (overage credits applied).
2) Clear indication of any VAT treatment or reverse-charge requirements for our EU entity (we are UK-registered).
3) Bank/wire instructions and the expected beneficiary name on your side.
4) Whether Redwood will accept a PO conversion into an invoice header (we prefer PO# 4287).

We can route the escrow release once we see the signed settlement and the consolidated invoice. If you need any additional docs from our side (TIN, VAT cert), let me know — I can attach them.

Thanks,

Greenleaf Health Inc.

- Karthik will include a VAT handling note (reverse charge vs. gross) and confirm whether we need your VAT cert/TIN on file.
- Kimberly will confirm beneficiary name and provide the wire instructions; we can accept PO 4287 as the invoice header.
- Vanessa will prepare a short release checklist for escrow (signed settlement + invoice + PO + VAT doc).

Can you confirm: do you need a single consolidated invoice or a two-invoice approach (one for subscription + one for true-up)? Greenleaf prefers single invoice where possible.

Im copying the finance and account ops leads to keep this moving. Goal: get you a finalized packet by Friday (2028-12-01) for your treasury cutover Monday.

Best,
